description: Token & Cost. Cost is derived query-side from cumulative token counters times flat placeholder rates (USD per 1M tokens: input 1.0, output 3.0), so every model is costed without a hardcoded model list. It is not a telemetry metric; replace the flat rates with a per-model price catalog when real prices are available.

panels.description: Estimated USD spend in the window (flat placeholder rates). Arrow compares with the immediately preceding window of the same length.

targets.expr: (sum((sum by (gen_ai_request_model)(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_input_tokens_total{service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_agent_name!=""}[$__range])) * 1.0 / 1e6) + (sum by (gen_ai_request_model)(increase(gen_ai_client_inference_usage_output_tokens_total{service_name=~"$application", gen_ai_agent_name=~"$agent", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_agent_name!=""}[$__range])) * 3.0 / 1e6))) > 0

panels.title: Total Cost

panels.description: Average spend per hour across the window (burn rate).
